title: Maths reference: Year 7 Probability
summary: The words and methods from Year 7 Probability, each with an example and, where it helps, a picture of the board.
_about: Maths cards for maths/probability-7 (see snippets/maths-algebra-7.json for the format; split from the strand courses' card files on 1 Nov 2026).

items.label: sample space
items.hint: Every possible outcome, listed once. Check whether the outcomes are equally likely.

items.label: probability
items.hint: For equally likely outcomes. Otherwise use sizes or counts. From 0 (impossible) to 1 (certain); all outcomes add to 1.
items.board:
widget: chance
device: spinner
outcomes: red 2, blue 1, green 1
watch: blue
seed: 4
items.shows: A half-red spinner: P(red) = 1/2, P(blue) = P(green) = 1/4

items.label: expected count
items.hint: Expected count = probability × trials. Real results vary around it, more so in short experiments.

items.label: relative frequency
items.hint: The experiment's estimate of the probability. Over many trials it settles close to the probability (the law of large numbers); nothing is ever 'due'.
items.board:
widget: chance
device: coin
seed: 2
start: 2000
items.shows: 2000 flips: the relative frequency of heads settles near 0.5
